reuse.why: Routes all five inline midpoint copies (schedule-template, forecast, updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule, preview) through the existing exported getScheduledAmount helper instead of rewriting them.

duplication.why: Removes the duplicated midpoint expressions; the new worst-case rule exists only once, inside getScheduledAmount.

placement.why: The rule change lands in shared/schedules.ts, where the tree already keeps the amount resolution used by client and server.

scope.why: Only the helper, its consumers and a focused unit test are touched; comments updated to match.

maintainability.why: A future change to the expected-amount rule is now a one-line edit in one function covered by tests.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All server and shared call sites now use getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic remains; copies were deleted, not reshaped.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount; every path (budget template, forecast, action sync, posting, preview, client tables/balance) calls it.
